t: Powerful Makita MR007GZ site radio provides reliable audio entertainment and information for any professional work environment. The robust unit features DAB+ and FM tuners to offer clear digital and analogue radio reception across sites in the UK. Bluetooth connectivity allows for seamless audio streaming from mobile devices, making it ideal for workshops, construction areas, or outdoor installations. Equipped with dual speakers which deliver 95dB of volume, and an IP65 rating allowing it to withstand dust and splashes. Power options include a 230VAC mains adaptor or various Makita 12V, 18V, and 40V lithium-ion batteries for ultimate flexibility.
